advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_ess: Distill a plant's nature into a bottle and begin the alchemical path.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_pot: Obtain any Herbcraft herbal potion. The herb enters the bottle, and the contract begins.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_cla: Obtain any clarified potion: keep the clean virtue, leave the murk behind.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_mur: Obtain any murky potion: preserve the toxin for another use.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.epic_poti: Obtain an exceptional advanced potion. Refinement has made this medicine uncommon.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_coa: Obtain or use a coated weapon. A plant's nature can cling to an edge, too.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.witch_kno: Discover the link between witches and herbal alchemy; their bottles still taste of wild herbs.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.survive_w: Survive a witch's safe murky brew. Toxin is danger, but also study.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.lin: Alchemy puts herb nature into bottles and blades. The Alchemy chapter explains essences, potions, and coatings.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.ess: You have obtained an essence. This overview only points the way; the Alchemy chapter holds the paths and refinements.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.pot: You have obtained an herbal potion: medicine begins to obey recipe.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.ref: You have seen clarification or murk: keep the clean virtue, or preserve the toxin.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.coa: You have seen coating: a plant's nature can cling to an edge.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.alchemy.non: If you want steadier medicine, begin with extractable herbs and glass bottles.
guide.herbcraft_alchemy.first_essence: An essence bottles a plant's nature. Alchemy is steadier than raw eating, but it asks for a contract.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.overview.li: Alchemy bottles a plant’s nature. It is steadier than raw eating, but asks for a contract.
Essence is the entry, potions are the path, and coatings are the outward use.
The newer alchemy system preserves source pharmacology and links processing style, body-state medicine, relation context, and processing materials back into Codex experience.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.overview.no: If you do not know where to begin, seek an extractable herb and catch its essence in a glass bottle.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.overview.fi: You have obtained an essence: plant nature now has a bottled form.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.overview.po: Potion entries also follow a taste gate: seeing one gives a name, while drinking begins to reveal source, thermal, qi, and processing semantics.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.overview.ar: Distilled essences can also support armor: this is not retaliation, but help for bearing processed medicine.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.essences.li: Not every herb is suited for extraction. Those that are can hand part of their nature to a glass bottle.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.essences.no: Before you see an essence, remember only this: extraction needs something worthy and a bottle to hold it.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.essences.kn: You have seen %s essences. They are roots for potions and keys to other alchemical work.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.potions.lin: Potions make medicine obey a recipe. Compared with raw eating, they offer less accident and more cost.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.potions.aft: Essence is only the root. To make medicine, follow the brewing stand and let nature enter water.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.potions.fir: You have obtained an herbal potion: medicine no longer flares only in the mouth, but can be kept in a bottle.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.potions.pro: Processing now means more than strong or long: sustained draws out the tail, intense sharpens the surge, and purified filters murk into a steadier medicine.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.potions.rel: Processed potions now also carry recent medicinal momentum into the body, so they can continue, buffer, or aggravate later relations.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.clarified_m: One medicine, two roads. Clarification keeps the clean virtue; murk preserves the toxin.
You have seen clarification: impurities fall away and beneficial medicine steadies.
You have seen murk: toxin is preserved for another purpose.
Clear and murky are not simply strong and weak; they are different uses.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.quality_bon: Advanced potions are not all alike. Quality and aftertaste can make the same path differ.
These processing styles now also project pharmacology semantics: thermal bias, qi movement, clarity level, and relation tendency all travel with the method.
Honeycomb clarifies, redstone carries the tail, glowstone sharpens the edge, and amethyst steadies the bearing; these are process semantics, not only ingredients.
When a potion path deepens, the bottle may carry aftertaste or impurity; not every brew is identical.
You have seen exceptional potency: at this refinement, a potion is no mere repeat of its recipe.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.coatings.li: Medicine need not enter only the mouth. With adhesion, herb nature can cling briefly to a blade.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.coatings.af: If an essence does not enter a bottle, an adhesive may hold it to a weapon for a time.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.coatings.fi: You have seen coating: each hit is a brief release of herb nature.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.armor_suppo: Armor support attaches distilled essence to armor so the body can better bear processed medicine.
It is buffering and bearing support, not thorns, retaliation, or extra damage.
With distilled essence, adhesives, and a smithing table, armor can become a support surface.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.witch.title: Witches and Murk
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.witch.line1: A witch’s bottle also tastes of wild herbs. They know dangerous, short-lived murky methods.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.witch.knowl: You have glimpsed the witch’s notes: not every murky brew is meant to kill; some disturb and test.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.witch.survi: You survived a witch brew. Short murk can teach the edge of safety.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.witch.undea: You have touched Undead Venom: some medicine paths are not for healing, but for restraining what should not move.
The medicine settles; your body bears it steadily again.
Processed medicine warms in the body. Burden is building.
Medicinal burden strains your movement slightly.
Your body is overloaded by processed medicine.
tooltip.herbcraft.distilled_essence.orie: Honeycomb clarifies and tames murk, leaving a cleaner medicine.
Redstone draws out the tail and carries the medicine onward.
Glowstone sharpens the edge and intensifies the surge.
Amethyst steadies the bearing for later co-processing harmony.
tooltip.herbcraft.armor_support.clear_be: Stabilizes processed medicine and buffers potion burden.
tooltip.herbcraft.armor_support.steady_b: Draws out tail burden and helps the body carry long medicine.
tooltip.herbcraft.armor_support.braced_b: Braces the body against sharp processed medicine.
The medicine remains steady under your bearing.
Medicinal heat stirs upward through your body.
Cold medicinal force begins to stagnate your movement.
The medicine rebounds from an overdriven peak.
Murky medicine disturbs your body state.
Your qi scatters under the medicine's pull.
Medicinal qi stagnates and weighs you down.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_dis: Obtain a distilled essence with a specific alchemical orientation.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_sus: Obtain a sustained processed potion and feel its longer tail.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_int: Obtain an intense processed potion and feel its sharper peak.
advancements.herbcraft_alchemy.first_arm: Attach distilled essence to armor so the body can better bear processed medicine.
book.herbcraft_alchemy.guide.armor_suppo: After your first armor support, compare support orientation, potion processing style, and burden result when choosing gear.
